reason: I already have a hoodie I wear every week and I can get a decent tee on Depop or Vinted for $10 to $15, so $38 for a new one is hard to justify on $36k. 15% off doesn't change that.
objection: I can't try it on, so what if the size is wrong? A boxy fit is hard to judge from photos, and I'd be paying $38 or more to find out.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns if the size is wrong, so I could send it back without losing money.
